lines.en: Okay, I'm making a break for it. I'm going out the window.
No, no, no, don't. Please, look.
I've been waiting for, like, forever to go out with Lorraine.
Calm down. Calm down. You set me up with a woman I've dumped twice in the last five months.
Can you stop yelling? You're making me nervous, and...
I can't go when I'm nervous.
I'm sorry. I'm sorry. You're right.
Come on! Do it! Do it! Come on!
